searchText: Reporting back, the prsym-geth local devnet has now been fine for ~4d. I think last time we saw issues around the 5d mark, but 100% perf the entire time is a good sign tbh 😄 So once Jimmy is ready with a lighthouse image, I'd love to try that out in a mixed devnet 😄 Perhaps if we find something, then the peerDAS call tomorrow is the perfect avenue to discuss it Amazing. By any chance did you use these flags? - `--data-columns-withhold-count` - `--data-columns-ignore-slot-multiple` used this config from you 🙂 ``` participants_matrix: el: - el_type: geth cl: - cl_type: prysm cl_image: ethpandaops/prysm-beacon-chain:peerDAS-revert-failing-commit-develop-d545409 vc_image: ethpandaops/prysm-validator:peerDAS-revert-failing-commit-develop-d545409 cl_max_mem: 4096 count: 2 cl_extra_params: - --minimum-peers-per-subnet=1 - --subscribe-all-subnets - --log-format=json vc_extra_params: - --log-format=json - cl_type: prysm count: 1 cl_image: ethpandaops/prysm-beacon-chain:peerDAS-revert-failing-commit-develop-d545409 vc_image: ethpandaops/prysm-validator:peerDAS-revert-failing-commit-develop-d545409 cl_max_mem: 4096 cl_extra_params: - --minimum-peers-per-subnet=1 - --log-format=json - --data-columns-withhold-count=64 vc_extra_params: - --log-format=json - cl_type: prysm count: 1 cl_image: ethpandaops/prysm-beacon-chain:peerDAS-revert-failing-commit-develop-d545409 vc_image: ethpandaops/prysm-validator:peerDAS-revert-failing-commit-develop-d545409 cl_max_mem: 4096 cl_extra_params: - --data-columns-ignore-slot-multiple=20 - --minimum-peers-per-subnet=1 - --log-format=json vc_extra_params: - --log-format=json network_params: electra_fork_epoch: 1 fulu_fork_epoch: 2 snooper_enabled: true global_log_level: debug additional_services: - dora - spamoor_blob - prometheus_grafana dora_params: image: ethpandaops/dora:fulu-support ethereum_metrics_exporter_enabled: true ``` Oh ok so there is these 2 options. I'm really glad to see the network is surviving to the quite aggressive `--data-columns-ignore-slot-multiple=20` option for multiple days 🙂 Thanks! Yess! Great progress 😄

excerpts.author: parithosh
excerpts.content: Reporting back, the prsym-geth local devnet has now been fine for ~4d. I think last time we saw issues around the 5d mark, but 100% perf the entire time is a good sign tbh 😄

excerpts.author: parithosh
excerpts.content:
So once Jimmy is ready with a lighthouse image, I'd love to try that out in a mixed devnet 😄
Perhaps if we find something, then the peerDAS call tomorrow is the perfect avenue to discuss it

excerpts.author: manunlp
excerpts.content:
Amazing. By any chance did you use these flags?
- `--data-columns-withhold-count`
- `--data-columns-ignore-slot-multiple`

excerpts.author: parithosh
excerpts.content:
used this config from you 🙂
```
participants_matrix:
  el:
    - el_type: geth
  cl:
      - cl_type: prysm
        cl_image: ethpandaops/prysm-beacon-chain:peerDAS-revert-failing-commit-develop-d545409
        vc_image: ethpandaops/prysm-validator:peerDAS-revert-failing-commit-develop-d545409
        cl_max_mem: 4096
        count: 2
        cl_extra_params:
          - --minimum-peers-per-subnet=1
          - --subscribe-all-subnets
          - --log-format=json
        vc_extra_params:
          - --log-format=json
      - cl_type: prysm
        count: 1
        cl_image: ethpandaops/prysm-beacon-chain:peerDAS-revert-failing-commit-develop-d545409
        vc_image: ethpandaops/prysm-validator:peerDAS-revert-failing-commit-develop-d545409
        cl_max_mem: 4096
        cl_extra_params:
          - --minimum-peers-per-subnet=1
          - --log-format=json
          - --data-columns-withhold-count=64
        vc_extra_params:
          - --log-format=json
      - cl_type: prysm
        count: 1
        cl_image: ethpandaops/prysm-beacon-chain:peerDAS-revert-failing-commit-develop-d545409
        vc_image: ethpandaops/prysm-validator:peerDAS-revert-failing-commit-develop-d545409
        cl_max_mem: 4096
        cl_extra_params:
          - --data-columns-ignore-slot-multiple=20
          - --minimum-peers-per-subnet=1
          - --log-format=json
        vc_extra_params:
          - --log-format=json
network_params:
  electra_fork_epoch: 1
  fulu_fork_epoch: 2
snooper_enabled: true
global_log_level: debug
additional_services:
  - dora
  - spamoor_blob
  - prometheus_grafana
dora_params:
  image: ethpandaops/dora:fulu-support
ethereum_metrics_exporter_enabled: true
```
